1. This petition has been filed seeking regular bail for the petitioner in FIR No.176/2108 registered under Sections 420/467/468/471/120B/34 IPC at PS Dwarka North, New Delhi.
The petitioner has been in custody since 16.08.2022 and the chargesheet has been filed.
2. Issue notice.
3. Ld. APP accepts notice.
This application has been moved for interim bail to the petitioner during pendency of the case on the ground that the petitioner's father is suffering from last stage cancer and she has two minor children and there is nobody to look after and take care of the children.

Trial Court, further subject to the following conditions:
i. Petitioner will not leave the country without prior permission of the Court.
The petitioner shall intimate the Court by way of an affidavit and to the IO regarding any change in residential address.
iii. Petitioner shall appear before the Court as and when the matter is taken up for hearing.
iv. Petitioner shall join investigation as and when called by the IO concerned.
v. Petitioner shall provide all mobile numbers to the IO concerned which shall be kept in working condition at all times and shall not switch off or change the mobile number without prior intimation to the IO concerned.
The mobile location be kept on at all times.
vi. Petitioner will report through video call to the Investigating Officer,
PS DIU Dwarka every Saturday between 4 to 5 p.m. vii.
Petitioner shall not indulge in any criminal activity and shall not communicate with or come in contact with any of the prosecution witnesses, the victim/complainant or any member of the victim/complainant's family or tamper with the evidence of the case.

This petition has been filed seeking interim bail for the petitioner in FIR No.176/2018 PS Dwarka under sections 420/467/468/471/120B/34 IPC.
2.
The petitioner was earlier granted interim bail for a period of 3 weeks vide order dated 28th March, 2023 on account of illness of her father.
The petitioner was released on bail 3rd April, 2023,
duly complied with terms and conditions of the bail and surrendered on 24th April, 2023.
3. Unfortunately, the father of the petitioner has expired on 12th May, 2023 and was cremated on 13th May, 2023.
The last rites of the father are to be performed at the native place: Village Chakia,
Post Pur, District Ballia, U.P.
4. The fact of the death of father of the petitioner has already been verified by the State.
